name: Bir İhtimal Daha Var
summary: A down-and-out sports betting writer is roped into teaming up with the ghost of a bossy business tycoon demanding to crack his own murder case.

name: Loose Women: Just Between Us…
summary: Join a different dynamic duo every episode for more conversation after the show ends, with extra laughs and deeper discussions than ever before.

name: Flying Through History
summary:
A thrilling drone's eye view of history. This series of short documentaries offers a dynamic perspective on British history through hard-to-access places and untold stories. Agile drones bring us to historic locations we would not normally be able to visit, and enable us to see them from angles and heights we'd never be able to experience otherwise.

As well as the historical information, the films are intended to be a visceral viewing experience in which the sheer pleasure of flying through narrow spaces and into apertures is at the core. The distinctive, entertaining narration is delivered by the popular British comedian Paul Chowdhry, who mixes a fascination for history with an irreverent, surreal sense of humour. Each episode features a different, contrasting location, and the programmes range across historic periods and themes, from the Mediaeval to the Victorian, from the dissolution of the monasteries to the boom in the railways.

name: Vince
summary: Vince, a charming Breakfast TV host, endures a grave trouser malfunction at the children's cancer ward on live TV, and must navigate the aftermath to save his reputation.

name: Queen of the Castle
summary:
The hour-long, eight-episode series follows Canadian socialite Dr. Ann Kaplan Mulholland and her entrepreneur husband Dr. Stephen Mulholland as they turn their lives upside down after the last of their six children leaves home. The two empty-nesters move to England and take on the ambitious task of turning their newly acquired medieval castle in the heart of Kent, U.K. into a luxurious world-class destination.

Set in the quiet English town of Hythe, the arrival of Ann, a force of nature with grand plans and the business savvy to pull it off, takes the local community by storm. With her husband Stephen – a world-renowned plastic surgeon– at her side, the pair are ready to give Lympne Castle the makeover of its century-long lifetime. With a dedicated team of castle staff and tradesmen supporting the renovation, they contend with construction chaos, quirky events, discerning guests, and so much more. Along the way, Ann forges unexpected friendships – from elderly neighbours to the town Vicar – and what she initially saw as a business opportunity quickly evolves into something much more personal.

name: Чужой район
summary:
Andrei Frolov, an employee of the criminal investigation Department, is a white crow. He does not like the work methods of his colleagues, he does not want to participate in interrogations that are conducted using violence and pressure. After Andrei has neutralized the criminal, who turned out to be the grandson of an influential person, he is given an ultimatum: he must leave the wanted list at his own request, or... 

Andrey is transferred to the precinct, and by someone's "ill will", he is entrusted with the most difficult criminal plan, a remote area called "Molot" (Red Hammer). This is a microdistrict on the outskirts of the Metropolis, a former workers' settlement named after the Red Molotoboits. The nearest metro station is 15 minutes away by minibus, which runs "once a year as promised."

A neighborhood with the typical charms of residential and working-class areas. It looks like the Wild West in some ways - it has its own laws, everyone is their own defender. In fact, the district is governed by an Authority (here the law is him). Life in the area is harsh, but for the most part, its inhabitants, despite their unpretentiousness and simplicity, turn out to be correct and real.

name: Dream
summary: Years ago, journalist Shen Leshui documented the lives of workers at the old Lacheng Brewery. Now she returns to Lacheng with her camera, searching for stories forgotten by time. As she revisits the lives of Cao Jun, Tu Chunyan, Qian Yichuan and Cheng Youtian, buried memories and hidden truths slowly come to light.

name: 9-1-1: Nashville
summary: A high-octane procedural about heroic first responders, as well as their family saga of power and glamour set in one of America's most diverse and dynamic cities.

name: The Chief
summary: A deep dive into the daily duties of Chief Commissioner Cameron Miekelson from the Scottish Police Force. This series sees The Chief at work and at home dealing with colleagues, bams and family alike. As Miekelson wrestles with contemporary dilemmas and navigates workplace politics, he must do his best to remain relevant in an ever-changing world.

name: Seeking Satoshi: The Mystery Bitcoin Creator
summary: Podcaster and journalist Gabriel Gatehouse sets out to solve the biggest mystery in tech: who is Satoshi Nakamoto, the elusive creator of Bitcoin? But Gabriel realises in fact he's on a much bigger story. Is Bitcoin part of a conspiracy to end democracy and transform the world? Gabriel's journey takes in cryogenic freezing, old hackers on Caribbean islands, gun-toting libertarians who want to break free from the rest of the US, and gene editing in a private city state. This is a world of futuristic ideas that were once the preserve of geeks and misfits but, with Trump and Musk now in the White House, are increasingly mainstream. Bitcoin emerged in the wake of the 2008 financial crisis, invented by the pseudonymous Satoshi Nakamoto. Three years later, Satoshi disappeared.

name: Katie Piper: Locked Up in Louisiana
summary: Katie meets the inmates at notorious New Orleans Parish Prison, and delves into their cases to uncover what drove these women to commit the shocking crimes they've been accused of.

name: De F*ckulteit
summary: Lawyer Anouk Boone becomes the youngest candidate partner ever at her firm. Soon, stories start circulating about how she achieved this position. During her studies, she had an affair with the flamboyant professor Hartman. When all kinds of complaints about Hartman's transgressive behavior surface in the storm of #MeToo, Anouk's memories of him take on a different meaning.

name: Haite Kudasai, Takamine-san
summary: She can rewrite fate by changing her underwear... And now, a shy boy is trapped as her accomplice!

name: Плавучий университет
summary:
The project tells about the research of climate and ecosystem, about the state of the human body in Arctic conditions.

The research vessel "Professor Molchanov" rarely stands at the pier. Now for 3 weeks it is to become the Arctic floating university. The expedition route passes through the White, Barents and Kara seas. The team will go on a scientific journey to the distant lands of a unique natural zone.

previousepisode.name: Арктика: от первых Homo sapiens до поморов - загадки и традиции региона

name: Добрый день с Валерией
summary: Singer Valeria will show how to make every day rich and memorable. Together with experts and celebrity guests, the host will share life hacks on style, self-care, cooking, home organization, zoopsychology and many other everyday and routine things.

name: Bound by Sin
summary: She's the third daughter of the Jiang family, determined to defy societal norms and inherit the family business. She hires the low-born yet principled male lead as her bodyguard. Their worlds couldn't be more different. Her reckless behavior constantly challenges his limits, yet irresistibly draws him into a whirlpool of passion. But reality forces them apart—she's married off, and he enlists in the army. When the nation collapses and she falls into despair, he returns to save her. Amid the chaos, they finally confess their love.

name: Abolish Everything!
summary: On Abolish Everything!, comedian-abolitionists roast a pet peeve they want banned from society, while a panel of improvisers dubbed "The Political Establishment" argue on behalf of the status quo. The audience chooses their champion each episode, each of whom will come back to compete in the season finale.

name: Israel and the Palestinians: The Road to 7th October
summary: World leaders and their top advisers tell the inside story of two decades of conflict that saw diplomacy fail and Hamas's power grow, leading up to the attacks of 7th October 2023.

name: Piedone - Uno sbirro a Napoli
summary: Vincenzo Palmieri, a student of the famous Commissioner Rizzo "Piedone", returns to Naples to face his past. He must earn the trust of his new team and demonstrate the effectiveness of his unconventional methods in a complex city. Commissioner Sonia Ascarelli, his opposite, will give him a hard time. Between investigations full of twists and turns and light-hearted moments, Vincenzo will try to reconcile himself with his inner demons, while Naples continues to offer valuable life lessons.

name: Hunyadi
summary: Follows the fearless warrior Janos Hunyadi who defeated the Ottoman Army and defended Europe in 1456.

name: Running the World
summary: Max and Benj Cave are two of the UK's best free runners. They're now keen to explore the world and put their incredible skills to the test.

name: Onside: Major League Soccer
summary: Go beyond the pitch with unparalleled access to the players and personalities who power MLS. Electrifying moments and captivating stories made 2024 an unforgettable season - and gave us a glimpse of the future.

name: Fascynujące Miejsca
summary:
"Fascinating Places" - a journey to the wild places of the globe for free online on TVP VOD!

The authors of the German travel series invite viewers on a trip to amazing, little-known places all over the planet. They set off with their cameras to corners that captivate with their rich fauna and flora and delight with the beauty of their landscapes.

name: The Grudge
summary: Taking viewers inside sports' fiercest rivalries, where every game is more than a contest—it's a battle for pride, redemption, and legacy. Uncover the grudges that fuel legendary showdowns, turning rivalries into iconic moments in sports history.

name: The Tides That Bind: Inside Alabama Football
summary: A documentary series offering an intimate look at University of Alabama football during the transformative 2024 season. With Coach Kalen DeBoer stepping in after Nick Saban's legendary tenure, the series explores the core values that shape players into champions. More than just about wins and losses, it delves into athletic, academic, and spiritual growth, capturing the deep connections that bind the team, its community, and the enduring legacy of Crimson Tide football.

name: Crime Beat
summary: Small-town crime journalist Abhishek finds his life and career affected by a fugitive gangster. As he gets trapped in a web of lies and motives, what price will he pay- to become a renowned reporter?

name: Поворот ключа
summary: TV journalist Yuri Rogozin is trying to understand the circumstances of his colleague Nadezhda's death. The assumption that her death may be connected to a journalistic investigation leaves him no room for compromise or easy solutions, forcing him to go all the way.

name: Воскресенье в женской бане
summary:
The series takes place in a sports and beauty complex, where a group of friends, relatively young and well-off, gather on Sundays: after all, visiting a bathhouse in this complex is not a cheap pleasure. The women undergo health procedures and at the same time have endless conversations. Regular meetings on Sundays give the friends the opportunity to speak out: during the week, each of them has a lot of events that they need to tell each other about - and they share their experiences, ask each other for advice and, of course, gossip.

The viewers are presented with a whole gallery of women's destinies - so different and at the same time so similar. After all, all visitors to the "women's bathhouse" without exception are concerned with the same problems: money, sex, external attractiveness, relationships with husbands, lovers, children and parents, career ups and downs, fortune telling, dreams and omens. But the main thing is that all women are united by the eternal dream of simple human happiness...

name: Strangers You Know
summary: Strangers You Know is a hard-hitting crime documentary mini series in which each episode takes you to the heart of a brutal incident that gripped the nation.

name: Piyasa
summary: The series, produced by Pastel Film, explores a world where lives full of secrets collide amidst love, betrayal, and power struggles

name: Portobello
summary: This Italian drama tells the true story of beloved TV host Enzo Tortora, whose life is upended when he's falsely named in a criminal ring.

previousepisode.name: Heroic! The Great Battle for Earth
A very special investigation with Minju find the most dangerous(?) animal!

name: Bad Guys
summary: Jaka, a policeman filled with revenge, teams up with his junior, Sekar, and three inmates to hunt down a serial killer. Their research slowly reveals the dark side of the justice system that they have always believed in.

name: Sashes and Hearts
summary:
Jack is a determined and passionate candidate who wins a national pageant and gears up for an international competition. However, as he chases his dream, he faces the harsh realities and controversies surrounding male pageantry, putting his resilience and integrity to the test. 

This is the Journey of Jack, Tomas, and the rest of the candidates as they fight for the crown—and for something even greater.

name: Espartanos. Una historia real
summary: "Coco" Oderigo, an upper-class lawyer, founds the Spartans, the first rugby team in a prison.

name: About That with Andrew Chang
summary: Andrew Chang goes beyond the headlines and explains the major news stories everybody is talking about.

name: Stan Can
summary: Meet Stanley, the can-do hamster who is always happy to help whenever a job needs doing.

name: ISL Weekly Weather
summary: The latest national weather forecast with Irish Sign Language (ISL).

name: CBC Newsroom with Deana Sumanac-Johnson
summary: Deana Sumanac-Johnson brings Canadians the latest breaking news and live coverage from across Canada and around the world.

name: Cross Country Checkup on CBC News Network, with Ian Hanomansing
summary: A lively discussion on an issue of national interest. Hosted by Ian Hanomansing. Simulcast with CBC Radio One.

name: CBC Newsroom with Aarti Pole
summary: Aarti Pole brings Canadians the latest breaking news and live coverage from across Canada and around the world.

name: CBC Newsroom with Andrew Nichols
summary: Andrew Nichols in Toronto brings Canadians the latest breaking news.

name: Nismet
summary: A 16-year-old high school student, Nismet lives in a small town in the Marseille region, between a depressed mother and a tyrannical and violent stepfather. While the latter tries to sexually assault her and faced with the passivity of her mother, the young girl runs away. From home to home, and faced with the tragedy that will soon affect her family, she will have to find the path to emancipation and free herself from its independence.

name: Inanma
summary: In 1989 Dalhousie, Kismat's arrival and a mysterious bracelet lead to unexplained events that make Jeet and her question what's happening around them?

name: Viril
summary: The ideal of masculinity - as unattainable as it is frustrating - is in crisis. The series Virile delves into the history and myths of masculinity with humor and wit.

name: Sao Chai Hi-Tech
summary: Nol Ratsamee is a heartbroken, woman-hating, completely introverted, angry, handsome young man. His former girlfriend screwed him over and left him for his best friend, and took his money. His depressive state and views on love and women garner the attention of his younger sister, who is very concerned, so she teams up with her bubbly/cheerful best friend Reuangrin Narokmon to find him a girl and to make him be ‘happy' again. Reungrin moves into their home as a maidservant to get close to Nol, to know his habits and likes, so that she can play his matchmaker. But a problem arises, and Reuangrin begins to fall for Nol.

name: Meesni
summary: Meesni is a story that revolves around Sahira, played by Maham Shahid, a young, beautiful but cunning girl who leaves no stone unturned to get what she wants. She has always deceived people including her own family by constantly lying to them. She manipulates people for her personal gains. She uses all malicious ways to get whatever she lacks through different ploys. HUM TV presents the drama Meesni as a story of greed, deception and repercussions. Featuring the versatile Sharmeen Kashif, Bilal Qureshi, Maham Shahid in lead roles, the serial sheds light on malicious motives of people for greed and complexes. Repercussions of blind trust and effects on generations to come.

name: History Of Losers
summary: A story about love and relationships that could turn anyone into a loser. It will be portrayed in the form of a romantic comedy that shows the inherent pathetic sides of people and diverse thrilling moments that come with various forms of love. The hyperrealistic depiction of humans at their lowest will be accompanied by laughter and empathy that goes beyond discomfort. Seo Min Ki is a freshman in college who is majoring in Korean literature. He is a hesitant person with a lot on his mind who sometimes makes bold actions. Being a 20-year-old, the result of his actions are always a series of clumsiness and mistakes. However, because he's someone who thinks a lot and has an ideological personality, he always self-reflects. He is a simple outsider whose only wish is to drink with his friends and play games at internet cafes.

name: Lana Longbeard
summary: Lana is a super-feisty, forward-thinking and passionate 11-year-old girl, who is also the heir to her father's adventuring ship, the Mighty Windbreaker. Along with her captain dad and his diverse crew (an orc, a dwarf, a barbarian and a cyclops), she sails across the Ten Realms, dreaming of becoming one of the greatest adventurers of all time. But first, she must overcome some challenging obstacles: impulsivity, stubbornness, extreme curiosity, disdain for rules … and a love of pancakes. All the best things about her!

name: Toad & Friends
summary: Kenneth Grahame's literary classic ‘Wind in the Willows' springs to life in this series following the further adventures of the much loved characters: kind and considerate Mole, reliable Rat and of course incorrigible Toad. Situated on and around the river that is such a big part of their lives and landscape, they are now joined by irrepressible Hedge the Hedgehog, Kingfisher, Heron and Adder.

name: Leaders off the Record
summary: Archie Pepper interviews four of the Scottish party leaders.

name: The Chief Does Edinburgh
summary: Chief Cameron Miekelson gives viewers his unique take on the nation's capital, looking at the history, geography and literature of Edinburgh, including a heated discussion with acclaimed author Ian Rankin.

name: Novelette Is Trying
summary: Dumped and broke, Novelette, a queer Black woman, gets a roommate, Audre. Their contrasting personalities clash. Novelette confronts her dependency issues, gains confidence, and pursues love as she learns to stand on her own.

previousepisode.name: Novelette is Trying to Be Mature

name: CBC News: Live News Special
summary: Special coverage on CBC News Network.

name: Ceolaireacht
summary: Doireann Ní Ghlacáin heads off with her fiddle on her back, to find out what is happening at the heart of the traditional Irish music scene in four different areas around Ireland. We've been told for years that west Clare, Sliabh Luachra and Donegal are where it's at in terms of trad, but is that still the case? Doireann delves into the music scene in less recognized areas, musically speaking, to see who is playing, what they are playing and where the craic is at.

name: Kan Bu Jian De He Yue Lian Ren
summary: At the engagement banquet between the Ling and Gao families, the Gao patriarch and his daughter attempt to humiliate Ling Feng using the attending media. However, Ling Feng preemptively strikes, dramatically declaring to the press that his true fiancée is Xu Ya—a blind cellist invited to perform at the event. Yet Xu Ya, who appears to be an unwitting pawn in this power play, is far from the innocent victim she appears to be…

name: Screwballs
summary: Five siblings face endless missions in this pure entertainment variety show. With a few screws loose, they embrace chaos in their search for sanity.

name: Tylko jedno spojrzenie
summary: Greta's life unravels after finding a mysterious photograph of her husband from years ago. When he disappears, she is forced to uncover his dark past.

name: Elixer
summary: In Elixer Isabelle Rombauts becomes totally unexpected the CEO of family business Rombauts Pharma, an important player on the international pharmaceutical market. She soon encounters the consequences of serious mismanagement by her father and brother. And she is faced with a devilish dilemma: should she follow her own conscience? Or the interests of her influential family?

name: Japan's Number One Jerk Salaryman
summary: Hoping to improve his reputation, disgraced ex-TV reporter Ippei runs for City Council and moves in with his late sister's husband and his family to win.

name: La Ruina
summary: Tomàs Fuentes and Ignasi Taltavull comment on and judge the worst anecdote of the people who come to the program from the public. The most miserable story wins a prize.

name: Millionaire Murders
summary: This series explores the intersection of extreme wealth and violent crime, investigating how the pursuit of money, power, and status can lead to murder. Each episode focuses on a high-profile case, where either the victim or the perpetrator had considerable wealth, examining the motivations behind the crimes and the investigations that followed. With expert commentary and archive footage, the series delves into the often-complex factors that contribute to such crimes. Cases featured include the murder of William Saunderson-Smith, who lived ‘under the radar', using different identities to conceal a sprawling property empire in London and the killing of Anthony Ashley-Cooper, 10th Earl of Shaftesbury.

name: Britain's Countryside Killers
summary: This British series examines notorious murders that have had a lasting impact on rural communities in the UK. Each episode revisits a case that shocked once-peaceful towns and villages, highlighting how these seemingly idyllic settings were forever changed by violent crime. The series includes contributions from retired police detectives, forensic psychologists, and local journalists who provide detailed analysis of the investigative process behind each case.

name: Subterranea
summary: Subterranea, Kenya's first sci-fi series, follows eight participants of a psychological experiment who are placed in an underground bunker to test the effects of close-quarter secluded relationships on humans.

name: За гранью реального
summary:
Incredible events, modern achievements, cataclysms and mysterious coincidences, amazing inventions and mystical phenomena - all this will be told by three hosts of the program "Beyond the Real": Sergey Druzhko, Petr Korneev and Vasilisa Shatunova.

"Beyond the Real" is an educational project about events and phenomena that expand our horizons and turn our understanding of the world around us upside down! The daily TV magazine "Beyond the Real" covers the entire spectrum of interests of the audience that wants to learn more about this world and what is beyond reality.

What is a UFO? What threatens humanity? Who really lived on Earth before us? And much more...

name: Деньги не пахнут
summary: An entertaining TV game about inhuman greed

name: В гостях у деда-краеведа
summary:
Is it possible to walk around all of Russia and get acquainted with the life of each nation? Perhaps this is within the power of one Grandfather-Regionalist named Ignat Matveevich. He has lived in this world for so long that he has been able to visit almost every city in our unique country. Today he is ready to tell all TV viewers about his adventures.

The stories of Grandfather-Regionalist include the nature of Russian regions, so diverse and amazing, and the brightest cultural traditions of the peoples, and of course a local fairy tale!

name: Пан или пропал
summary: Quiet town in Danmark. Alicia is gathering her friends all over the world (mostly from Poland) to a party. Nothing special, but this night will became a murder mystery.

name: Eva Longoria: Searching for Spain
summary: Searching for Spain invites viewers to journey with Longoria across Spain's sun-drenched plains, rugged mountains and dramatic seascapes exploring its incredible wealth of cultures, climates and cuisines. This season, Longoria tastes her way through a bar crawl of pintxos in San Sebastián, Catalan prawns in Barcelona, and the iconic Spanish tortilla in Madrid. She ventures to the birthplace of tapas and samples some of the most expensive jamon in the world in Andalusia. In Galicia, she savors a bounty of fresh seafood and world class Galician blonde beef. Among the cider mills of Asturias, she explores the land of her ancestors and visits with family who still live in the town of Longoria to this day. Finally, audiences get a special peek into her new Spanish home in Marbella as she hosts a feast of local delicacies for her closest friends.

name: Condemned
summary: Condemned property investor and rehabber Kristyn Patterson and her builder father, Pancho Patterson, will stop at nothing to rescue The Motor City's worst houses that are destined for the wrecking ball. To breathe new life into the forgotten properties, Kristyn and Pancho will face harsh realities—including their hard-earned money on the line, squatters living in their houses, a brutal winter and the city's strict renovation deadlines—to help transform Detroit's historic neighborhoods.

name: The Calling: A Medical School Journey
summary:
Follow the intellectual and emotional journey of a group of medical students at Albert Einstein College of Medicine in the Bronx. Captured through verité scenes and personal video diaries, the film offers an inside look at America's healthcare system through the eyes of these aspiring practitioners as they learn what it takes to become a doctor in one of the country's most underserved communities.

Filmed in the corridors and classrooms at Albert Einstein — which announced in February 2024 that it is now tuition-free, thanks to a $1 billion gift from longtime faculty member Dr. Ruth Gottesman — and at its teaching hospital, Montefiore Medical Center, The Calling: A Medical School Journey follows the first-year students as they struggle to keep up with the punishing workload, meet and dissect their first cadavers, and engage with real patients for the first time. Meanwhile, the third-year students rotate through different medical specialties, juggling long shifts in the hospital with marathon study sessions for the all-important exams that will help determine where they will do their residencies. Through it all, the film chronicles the students' hopes, fears and incredible growth as they navigate the many challenges facing today's medical practitioners.

name: An Oprah Winfrey Special
summary: Oprah Winfrey hosts various primetime specials on ABC.

name: Tour De Fred: Northern Ireland
summary: Fred Sirieix - TV's favourite Frenchman - is setting the wheels in motion! Join him as he cycles on the spectacular and sometimes gruelling roads of Northern Ireland.

name: Cztery Pory Igi
summary: The report Cztery Pory Igi presents the most important moments of this season in chronological order. There will be no shortage of sporting competitions at the highest level and the thrills and excitement that accompany them.

name: Pop Whiz
summary: Pop Whiz is a travelling trivia game show that will challenge teens from across Canada on their Pop Culture Knowledge.

name: Mafia: Most Wanted
summary:
Mafia: Most Wanted offers audiences insight into the ‘Ndrangheta, a powerful Italian organized crime syndicate, and its deep roots in Canada, where its allegedly been involved in drug trafficking, theft, financial fraud, extortion, and murder. The series challenges the perception of the Mafia as an "open secret," shedding light on the inner workings of a Toronto crime family, and the individuals behind the infamous names.

Included in the docuseries are interviews with former mob enforcers Joe Ferraro and biker turned  police informant Cecil Kirby, plus crime writer James Dubro, investigative journalist Joseph Loiero, and retired RCMP sergeants Larry Tronstad and Brad Trainor. Their firsthand accounts, combined with undercover surveillance footage, wiretaps, police intelligence files, and dramatic recreations, paint a vivid and disturbing picture of the brutality of organized crime in Canada, and the devastating consequences of their actions.

name: Главные тайны мира
summary: We live in an era when everything seems easy to find a scientific explanation for. The planet has been studied far and wide. However, the world jealously guards its secrets, and scientists can only build hypotheses, trying to unravel them. The Lake of Skeletons in India, the ice worms of Antarctica, the rotating island in Argentina, the mysteries of chronomirages, the ghost train that disappeared in the fog, the secrets of the Blue Hole in the Red Sea, ... All this and other mysteries are in the REN TV channel project "The Main Secrets of the World".

name: Save the Date
summary: When successful wedding planner Dassy suddenly finds herself single again, her grandmother casts an ancient love potion to summon up Dassy's one true love. But something goes wrong with Grandma's spell, and suddenly Dassy is spoiled for choice! Instead of just "The One", Dassy now has four suitors from her past and present vying for her heart. With just two weeks to organize a high-stakes wedding for her high school mean girl, Dassy must navigate this romantic chaos and decide which man – if any – leads to her own "happily ever after".

name: Загадки человечества с Олегом Шишкиным
summary: An unexpected look at the most incredible events of history and modern times. You will travel to places that are not on the map, the mysteries of dangerous relics and ancient prophecies. Inexplicable facts and historical sensations of different eras will be studied - and will find a convincing explanation. The host of the program is a traveler, historian, specialist in secret societies, a world-renowned expert in the field of Eastern religions, the author of books on the history of the occult and intelligence.

name: Gospodin Savršeni
summary: The Croatian edition of The Bachelor. The series follows a single bachelor who is given a list of romantic interests from which he must choose a fiancée. During the season, the bachelor eliminates candidates each week which finally results in his last choice receiving a marriage proposal.

name: Pound 4 Pound
summary: When Lindiwe Mkhwanazi takes a team of women boxers to a major tournament, she must overcome sabotage from within her own organization.

name: La isla de las tentaciones
summary: Five couples agree to test their relationship by spending their vacation in separate corners of an island.

previousepisode.name: Los chicos se enfrentas a la primera hoguera

name: Belcanto
summary: Carolina, Antonia and her mother Maria escape to Milan after murdered her violent father, in the city Antonia seeks to follow her mother's dream of become a singer but shortly after they discover that the true talent lies with Carolina.

name: Trivia Loop
summary: As the clock ticks down, contestants need to think fast and recall facts quickly to score big. With quick-fire quizzes featuring five questions each, players dive into one of eight categories, like music, movies, TV, history, sports, and more.

name: Улица Шекспира
summary: One day, a woman from the past appears in the life of Moscow lawyer Mikhail – his first love, the daughter of a gypsy baron, Diana. She asks for help in releasing their daughter Yana from prison in exchange for keeping Mikhail's secret, because he is pretending to be someone else. In fact, he is a gypsy named Mihai Demetre, who was expelled from the camp 16 years ago. Mihai returns to the camp where he grew up to save the daughter he never knew existed and to face his past.

previousepisode.name: 26 выпуск | Александр Ваш, Алла Михеева, Янгер

name: Winter Gold
summary: Winter Gold is an intimate docuseries about the lives and driving forces behind seven winter sports athletes as they continue their quest for glory. It's the story of what it really takes to become the best.

name: The Ultimate Cycling Show
summary: Orla Chennaoui and Adam Blythe are joined by the stars of cycling for a comprehensive guide to bike racing on the track, road and in the mountains.

name: Derin Mor
summary: Arif and his daughter Ela try to escape the city in an ambulance with their neighbor Melek after an explosion in the sun creates chaos. While the journey inevitably leads to confrontations, Arif almost feels reconnected to himself after being crushed under the expectations of modern life for years.

name: VM-showet
summary: Helene Olafsen and Marius Skjelbæk invite you to a party on the day of the World Championships together with Petter Northug and Tiril Eckhoff. Meet medal winners, guests and artists.

name: Crushology 101
summary: If there were a guide for love, would Bunny not have been a pushover? Although she is crazy over good looks, Bunny believes sincerity is more important when dating. The result? Her first love with terrible looks and an awful personality turns out to be the worst, and she becomes known as a school-wide pushover. With the determination to never fail again, Bunny declares she will no longer act like a doormat and only date alpha males when four outstanding oppas appear before her. Bunny's heart gets no rest amid the endless parade of high-quality flirting, aimed to win her over and become her number one oppa. Is this a guide to stop being a pushover? Or is it a proper dating course for falling in love? Will Bunny the pushover transform into a dating genius?

name: Million Dollar Secret
summary: Million Dollar Secret In this cutthroat competition series, an undercover millionaire must hide in plain sight and evade elimination to keep the money and win the game.

name: Video HIts
summary: Video Hits was a Canadian music video program broadcast nationally on CBC Television from 1984 to 1993. Created by producer Sandra Faire, Video Hits aired weekday afternoons, and featured promotional music videos of the day's top hit songs from Canadian and international artists, along with artist interviews. The show's original host was Samantha Taylor. A similar music video show, Good Rockin' Tonite, also aired on CBC Television on Friday nights concurrently with Video Hits.

name: Teogonia
summary: Humans face demi-humans known as Kai, and a village boy will join the war in this tale of magic and mystery.

name: Gold & Greed: The Hunt for Fenn's Treasure
summary: Fortune or folly? In this documentary series, real-life treasure hunters dive into a years-long search for hidden riches in the Rocky Mountains.

previousepisode.name: When One Chest Closes, Another Opens

name: Круги на воде
summary:
Raya is forced to leave medical school and go to work for a cleaning company to pay for an expensive operation for her sick father Andrei Vetrov.

One day, while cleaning a luxury apartment, Raya meets the owner of the apartment, a representative of the golden youth Pavel Olkhovsky. The young people fall in love with each other. But Pavel's mother, the owner of a business empire Inga, is categorically against her son's relationship with a simple cleaner: she dreams of marrying him to the daughter of her main competitor Evgeny Sokolov. Together with the company's lawyer Viktor Danilov, Inga comes up with a plan to get rid of the girl. Will Raya be able to save her love and find happiness?..

name: Bullseye
summary:
The programme will follow the original format with the playing teams made up of an amateur dart player, known as the ‘thrower', and their team partner, the ‘knower'. They will combine their skills, throwing darts at different game boards, whilst answering questions correctly for ‘points and prizes'.

This brand new series, produced by ITV Studios, will also see professional darts players taking to the oche to help along the contestants and the return of Master of Ceremonies Richard Ashdown.

name: Sukaj
summary: A satirical black comedy TV series from Palestine and Jordan that addresses the difficult political and social challenges facing Arab communities.

name: Три аккорда
summary: The project covers the whole variety of genres of Russian music, not constrained by the framework of pop music, chanson, rock pop and classical music, while enjoying enormous popular popularity. The show's episodes are dedicated to urban romance, author's song, movie hits, cinema, the work of Russian emigration and some other genres.

name: Lewis & Clark: The Journey of the Corps of Discovery
Maloney
summary: Private detective Maloney investigates with mischief, charm and unmistakable thuggishness.

name: Киборг
summary: Evgeniy dreams of getting on a scooter, and Anna wants to stop being afraid and jump with a parachute. Maksim is a mentor and believes that his mentee will one day perform on the big stage. Each of them literally lost a part of themselves. They have lost an arm or a leg and do not yet know how to build their lives further. But each of them meets their guide, who will help them realize their dream and take a step into the future of cyborgs.

name: Залетела в тренды
summary: A waitress from a provincial karaoke bar, Sofia, accidentally ends up in Moscow for the talent show "Fly into Trends" in order to be closer to her boyfriend, Ilya, who is already a professional singer and is participating in the same show in a duet with his ex-girlfriend Katya.

name: Rock is a Lady's Modesty
summary: The young lady x rock youth story takes place in an all-girls' school where young, gorgeous, and ladylike girls from all over the country gather. A girl named Lilisa Suzunomiya, who became the daughter of a real estate tycoon after her mother remarried, gives up her guitar and love for rock music in order to act like a rich, young lady. But her passion for rock is rekindled when she meets a highly skilled drummer, who attends the same all girls' school.

name: Хрупкие убийцы
summary: Psychologists distinguish six types of female killers: the avenger, the angel of death, the bloody lady, Snow White's stepmother, the black widow and the mercenary killer. Journalist Oksana Shcherbakova will visit women's prisons, show their daily life and tell about several criminal types using real convicted women as examples, including the most brutal serial killer in Russia.

name: The Awakening of Housewives
summary: After the rich and beautiful Li Zhiqing marries self-made man Wang Yan, she becomes a full-time housewife, devoting herself to the family. However, it turns out that behind their seemingly happy marriage is the betrayal of her husband and best friend, who are cheating behind her back. When her father unexpectedly falls off a building, the company runs into trouble. Wang Yan, her once good husband, even shows his true colors, greedily competing with her to take control of the company. The awakened housewife fights back with all her might, showing no mercy in torturing the scumbag and seizing power, rewriting her life with great gusto.

name: There is No Place to Escape

previousepisode.name: Exclusive! The Wacky TV Fireworks Festival

name: Next Level Baker
summary: Next Level Baker will test the skills of bakers as they are challenged to create eye-popping, festive holiday delights across the franchise's three iconic levels. During the series' four special hours, only one baker will rise to the top and claim the holiday baking crown.

name: SC+
summary:
SC+ will be built around the highly popular "SC Top 10" daily countdown of sports moments. The program will deliver the most important sports news stories of the day, complemented by insights from ESPN's top insiders and reporters.

The fast-paced update will highlight each day's top sports moments, stories, insights and exclusive commentary in a more concise and streamlined format.

name: Залетай в тренды
summary: A show where any aspiring artist gets a chance to become trending by recording a track with a top artist. In times when information is consumed very quickly, we will show that you can win the love of the audience in literally 30 seconds and you don't need anything other than your talent to do this.

name: Финист. Первый богатырь. Фильм о фильме
Tuiskoms
summary: When a video of Fleur's lowest moment goes viral, she loses everything she has, forcing her to move back in with her parents and start her life over.

previousepisode.name: Fleur and the Persistence of Memory

name: Чебурашка. История новогоднего чуда
summary: The creators of Cheburashka brought one of the most recognizable characters of Soviet animation to the big screen. In just two weeks of release, the family film broke the absolute box office record in Russia. But how was the new version of the story about the unknown little animal born? Why did actress Olga Kuzmina, who "gave" Cheburashka her voice, have to talk to an imaginary Gena? And who came up with the final image of the "eared one"?

name: Medusa
summary: Somebody wants to kill CEO Bárbara Hidalgo. Can she find the culprit as her family schemes ruthlessly for control of their Colombian business empire?

name: Три дня одного года
summary: Who are they, young scientists living in our country and continuing their scientific work for the benefit of Russia? What are they focused on today? What discoveries can we expect from them tomorrow? The documentary series is an attempt to reveal the personality of a young scientist from Russia, comprehensively, dedicating to him, his colleagues and relatives in one episode 3 key days from the life of each hero.

name: Untold Earth
summary: Untold Earth is a documentary series dedicated to unpacking the stories behind North America's strangest, most unique natural wonders.

previousepisode.name: It Looks Like a Desert. But It Has Thousands of Lakes

name: 4k Space Odyssey
summary: This series of short videos covers a wide range of space science stories, with stunning Ultra HD/4K images of Earth and its climate to planets and the universe at large. New videos added regularly.

previousepisode.name: What Scientists Are Seeing Over Greenland

name: No Time To Lose
summary: Nine individuals compete during a trip across South Africa. From the plains of the Kruger National Park to the spectacular coastline of The Garden Route.

name: For The Win: NWSL
summary: For the Win: NWSL is an immersive 4-part docuseries offering unprecedented access into the 2024 National Women's Soccer League (NWSL) playoffs and Championship. The series will take fans behind the scenes of one of the most thrilling seasons in NWSL history, chronicling the intensity, resilience, and passion that define the league's top teams and star players as they battle for the ultimate prize: the Championship trophy.

name: Sterling Point
summary: After discovering she's inherited a remote island in Canada from the estranged grandfather she was never allowed to meet, 17-year-old Annie Jacobson decides to investigate, pulling her into a world of buried secrets, unexpected sisterhood, and the complicated family history she was never meant to find.

name: The Fire Ghost of Caledonia Mills
summary: A real-life paranormal case based in the early 1900s in Antigonish County, Nova Scotia, about a farmhouse cursed with sudden fires.

name: Al Brown's Tipping Point Adventure
summary: Kiwi chef Al Brown sets out to make his mark on the world of New Zealand wine, going on a journey to start his own brand and meeting up with other local entrepreneurs along the way to see what makes them tick.

name: Leanne
summary: Leanne's life takes an unexpected turn when her husband of 33 years leaves her for another woman. Starting over when you're a grandmother and in menopause isn't exactly what she had in mind, but with the help of her family she will navigate this new chapter with grace, dignity and jello salad.

name: Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed
summary:
Paula, a newly divorced mom, falls down a dangerous rabbit hole of blackmail, murder, and youth soccer.

Convinced she witnessed a crime — while simultaneously struggling through a custody battle and an identity crisis — Paula begins her own investigation, one that could unravel a greater conspiracy while also holding the keys to rebuilding her family and sense of self.

name: Beside the Hearth at Alice-san's Home
summary: Minase Alice returned to her hometown from Tokyo for the first time in 10 years and reunited with her childhood friend, a high school boy named Harumi. The two childhood friends who have a difference in age are connected by the hearth of the old folk house where Alice lives.

name: No way back
summary: Former commando Ray guides sixteen adventurers through the wilderness. As they journey through the rugged Norwegian wilderness, the choice is one simple one: stay behind or keep going.

name: Voyage en cuisine
summary: Food geographer Pierre Raffard takes us on a culinary odyssey to discover the most exciting recipes from around the globe. Cooking Across the World sheds light on the influence of trade, colonisation and migration on food culture taking in recipes from street stalls to gourmet chef creations.

name: Mae Gen i Stori
summary: Stories and legends.

name: The Constitution: That Delicate Balance
summary: Constitutional issues come to life in this Emmy Award-winning series. Key political, legal, and media professionals engage in spontaneous and heated debates on controversial issues such as campaign spending, the right to die, school prayer, and immigration reform. This series will deepen understanding of the life and power of this enduring document and its impact on history and current affairs, while bringing biases and misconceptions to light.

previousepisode.name: Executive Privilege and Delegation of Powers

name: Dynasty
summary: A fictional chronicle of the rise and fall of Emperor Yung Jing of the Qing Dynasty, through sibling rivalry and rebellions by Ming loyalists.

name: Theme Song Takeover
summary: Theme Song Takeover is a comedy short series featuring characters from various Disney Channel shows performing theme song remakes of that series.

name: Broken Karaoke
summary: In Broken Karaoke, your favorite Disney Channel characters take the stage and sing hilarious parodies of iconic pop songs.

name: Ramsès le Grand
summary:
Featuring cutting-edge science and unique access to the latest archaeological discoveries, Ramsès le Grand exposes the man behind the myth. And reveals how—for the past few thousand years—this mighty ruler has remained a caricature of his own propaganda.

The pharoah's remarkable destiny unfolds in six spellbinding episodes that bring his astounding 67-year-rule to life—a legendary reign during which he turned a fallen empire into one of the most powerful realms of all time. It's an immersive journey that reveals Rameses' darkest secrets and lies along the way.

name: Pippi Hosanhir
summary: Children's puppet serial by Cardiff Caricature Theatre.

name: #Todas Debanhi: Una historia de redes
summary: Based on a rigorous journalistic investigation into three femicides that took place between March and April 2022 in the state of Nuevo León, in northern Mexico, the documentary series #Todas Debanhi: Una historia de redes offers an insider's view into two different types of networks: on the one hand, a network of complicity that allows violence against women to persist and, on the other hand, a network of resistance formed by family members and feminist activists to demand justice.

name: Meet Love Again
summary: Jia Jixiang and Sha Li, once strangers in a bustling city, cross paths by chance. Their journey from animosity to a whirlwind romance and flash marriage is tested by family ties, friendships, and life's struggles. After misunderstandings lead to divorce, they grow individually, only to reunite and rediscover their love.

name: Подруги
summary: Vera, Nadezhda and Lyubov are three friends. They have different characters and views on the world, but they always remain true to their friendship and overcome any challenges together.

name: Y Cowboi Bach
summary: Children's puppet serial

name: ABCiee Shūgyō Nikki
summary:
I'm Ebishi!
I dreamed of becoming a TV man, so I got a job at Ebishi TV...
But I never heard it would be this tough!!
The rules of the TV industry, my unique colleagues, the quirky performers,
and my slightly unusual family...
Will I really be able to become a top TV man?
Please keep a warm eye on me as I go behind the scenes of the TV industry and follow my struggles and turmoil!!!

previousepisode.name: Smiles and Tears, Ciee, at the Wrap Party!

name: The Fashionista
summary: Mariam's dream to inspire as a motivational influencer turns into a satirical tale of ambition, fame, and self-destruction.

name: Langs de Schelde
summary: Huub Stapel travels along the banks of the Scheldt, which starts in France and ends in the North Sea. He meets residents and explores the remarkable changes the river undergoes along the way.

name: Gareth Malone's Messiah
summary:
275 years after a ground-breaking charity concert saw George Frideric Handel perform his Messiah for the benefit of London's foundlings, Gareth Malone is set to stage his own performance of the nation's favourite choral piece in the magnificent surroundings of Cardiff's Llandaff Cathedral as a fundraiser for BBC Children in Need.

The programmes will see Gareth trim hundreds of applicants down to just eight singers who have never sung in a classical choir before, and then train them to perform a work that has dominated the British choral tradition for hundreds of years. Gareth's eight singers will reveal even the most inexperienced musicians can tackle Messiah as they bring enthusiasm and hard work to this once-in-a-lifetime challenge.

Gareth's new recruits, might not have tried choral music before or even heard of Handel, but they will have just seven weeks from audition to performing Messiah alongside the acclaimed BBC National Orchestra and Chorus of Wales. Also appearing will be a stellar professional cast of soprano Jessica Robinson, alto Rebecca Afonwy-Jones, baritone Roderick Williams OBE who sang at the King's Coronation, and tenor James Way.

name: L'arte della gioia
summary: The series L'arte della gioia tells the story of Modesta, a young Sicilian girl from the early 1900s who, born into poverty, fights to conquer love, freedom and power. After a tragic accident that tears her away from her family, she is welcomed into a convent where, thanks to her intelligence and stubbornness, she becomes the protégé of the Mother Superior. She later arrives at the villa of Princess Brandiforti, where she makes herself indispensable. This incessant movement of emancipation is accompanied by a path of personal and sexual maturation, which leads her to discover and claim the right to pleasure and happiness.

name: Life In Outer Space
summary: It's hard to believe that Earth is the only planet in the universe that's capable of sustaining life. Thanks to new technology, scientists have discovered planets and moons in our solar system, and beyond that may have had the qualities of a life-giving planet. Humans are destined to colonize the stars, but how far will we need to go to find a planet that can support us?

name: From the Ground Up
summary: Professional riders Ryan Peatry and Alexey Vermuelen both agree that cycling sports need to be more accessible and inclusive. Peatry, a mountain biker, and Vermuelen, a road cyclist, recognize the barriers beginner cyclists face when it comes to buying gear, training, and finding the motivation to race competitively. They've made it their mission to help new cyclists surmount those obstacles, and in Outside TV's new series From the Ground Up they work to show that anyone with enough determination can race with the pros.

name: Turning Teddy
summary: Three assistants attempt to navigate the worlds of their famous Hollywood bosses.

name: Herders - Guardians of The Earth
summary: Their lifestyle is considered ancient, but pastoralist people contribute in many ways to preserving ecosystems and food security worldwide. Their way of life is one of the oldest, yet from an ecological aspect, it points toward the future. Mark Michel and his team visit five pastoral communities around the world. Today, scientists all over the planet are discovering the enormous value of pastoral life. Together with the shepherds, they are looking for new ways to preserve this lifestyle and to use the pastorals' knowledge for a better agricultural future that benefits everyone.

name: The Disaster Diaries
summary: Record breaking cyclone activity. Explosive volcanic eruptions. Powerful earthquakes and endless heat waves. How do scientists forecast these cataclysms? Is it possible for people in affected areas to anticipate and prepare for these natural events? Using professionally shot 4K footage to capture the heart of the action, this series explores several major natural disasters of the last few years, from the most deadly to the most dramatic.

name: Stenbeck
summary: A reality-based drama series about controversial financier Jan Stenbeck who reluctantly takes over the family business Kinnevik and transforms it into a groundbreaking media empire. He makes many enemies, even within the family, and the price he pays is high.

name: The Great School Swap: UK to USA
summary: Two groups of teenagers swap schools and exchange lives between multicultural south London and the town of Mena, Arkansas, in America's bible belt.

name: Overview
summary: Overview combines aerial cinematography with science storytelling to reveal both the natural phenomena and human forces shaping our planet. The series will feature stories about agriculture, engineering, the environment and natural wonders told by the scientists, rangers, farmers and artists who are responsible for innovating the world around us.

previousepisode.name: Why Does This Swamp Keep Catching Fire?

name: Weathered
summary: From wildfires to hurricanes to tornadoes, Weathered will teach you about natural disasters from the people who have survived them, as well as what you can do to prepare.

previousepisode.name: We Just Crossed Our FIRST Tipping Point… And It's NOT What You Think

name: The American Revolution
summary:
The American Revolution was at once a war for independence, a war of conquest, a civil war, and a world war, fought by neighbors on American farms and between global powers an ocean or more away. It impacted millions from Vermont's Green Mountains to the swamps of South Carolina, from Indian Country to the Iberian Peninsula. In defeating the British Empire and giving birth to a new nation, the American Revolution turned the world upside-down. Thirteen colonies on the Atlantic Coast united in rebellion, won their independence, and established a republic that still endures.

The American Revolution, our six-part, twelve-hour series on America's founding struggle, will present the story of the men and women of the Revolutionary generation, their humanity in victory and defeat, and the crisis that they lived through. By weaving together accounts of American political leaders and their British counterparts with the perspectives of the so-called ordinary people who waged and witnessed war, The American Revolution will be an expansive, evenhanded look at the virtues and the contradictions in the fight for independence and the birth of the United States.

name: Katrina: Come Hell and High Water
summary: In Katrina: Come Hell and High Water, the people of New Orleans share their stories in their own words — from what it was like to survive the hurricane to how the city and their lives have been forever changed as a result. Brimming with emotion, the series serves as a testament to the resilience of New Orleanians and a stark call for vigilance and preparation as cataclysmic natural disasters continue to become more and more commonplace all over the world.

previousepisode.name: GOD TAKES CARE OF FOOLS AND BABIES

name: Spy High
summary: When teenager Blake Robbins files a lawsuit claiming his school is spying on him, it sparks a wild scandal with alarming digital privacy implications.

name: Travels With Agatha Christie & Sir David Suchet
summary: Sir David Suchet travels to locations Agatha Christie visited, immersing himself in countries she explored to uncover the literary enigma's inspirations.

name: The Clubhouse: A Year with the Red Sox
summary: Follows the Boston Red Sox during the 2024 MLB season with unprecedented access to players, coaches and executives.

name: Gone Girls: The Long Island Serial Killer
summary: This tense true-crime series examines the hunt for the Long Island serial killer through the perspective of his victims, their loved ones and the police.

name: A Body In The Snow: The Trial of Karen Read
summary:
Read is accused of killing her boyfriend John O'Keefe, a local police officer. On a cold January morning in a sleepy suburb outside of the city, a local police officer named John O'Keefe was found dead on a fellow officer's front lawn. Authorities, citing a toxic dynamic between O'Keefe and his girlfriend, Read, immediately narrowed in on Read as their main suspect. They alleged Read backed into O'Keefe with her car in a fit of passion and then left him to die in the snow – but Read maintains her innocence with her defense alleging something far more nefarious was at play.

A 2024 trial ended in a mistrial and a re-trial is planned for April. The docuseries examines the investigation and theories through access to key figures, as well as perspective into Karen's mindset during the 2024 trial.

name: Тело как гаджет
summary: The four-part series explores how modern technology and innovation affect our bodies and health. Each episode takes a closer look at key topics: mind, vision, skin, and blood. You'll learn about biohacking and how to start your own blood rejuvenation mechanism. The show also reveals special methods that will help people optimize their biological processes: from sleep and nutrition to physical activity and mental work. The show also addresses the ethics of using technology in medicine and considers what prospects and challenges await us in the future.

name: CAPSULES
summary: Capsules (often referred to as the Capsule Project) is an acclaimed anthology of original animated short films produced by Bilibili. Similar in concept to Love, Death & Robots, it showcases diverse 2D and 3D styles from Chinese indie animation studios, with each episode exploring unique themes based on color-coded human emotions.

name: 24 Health Club
summary: Do Hyeon-joong was once the star of "Mr. David," the premier bodybuilding competition in the U.S.—until he vanished without a trace. Now he's running a shabby 24-hour gym. After a terrible first night with her boyfriend, followed by an even worse breakup, Mi-ran signs up for Hyeon-joong's expensive personal-training plan, desperate to reboot her life. As Mi-ran fights to get fit and find herself again, Hyeon-joong's own world heads in unexpected directions. Can Hyun-joong prove himself as a rookie gym owner, and will Mi-ran rediscover her spark? Their sweaty, heart-warming reboot begins now.

name: Nebaidies ne no kā
summary: TV series about the most notorious Latvian drug trafficker Rolands Priverts. It's a story that gives insights of why and how the main character lived his life outside of the regular system and morals.

name: Айда!
summary: Grisha, a teenager from a privileged family, moves from Volgograd to Kazan and finds himself in the epicenter of a street gang war. He is a stranger in this world, but in order to survive, he has to learn its cruel rules. Zakharevich, the ideologue of the Tyap-Lyap gang, becomes an unexpected mentor for him. He is an intelligent, educated and ambitious manipulator who created a system for dragging teenagers into organized crime. The only one who is aware of the impending threat is the head of the criminal investigation department Nikonov. It will take time for him to understand that this is not just a criminal outburst, behind which there are non-ordinary figures, but the beginning of large-scale processes capable of destroying the country.

name: Leaked!
summary: Enter the life of Mumbai's elite attending the prestigious "Oakwood High School". Rebellious teenagers, bursting with emotions as they navigate their complex lives filled with secrets, we all would want to know. The ‘seemingly perfect' lives of privileged teenagers go for a toss when the ‘IT Girl' of the school is found dead.

previousepisode.name: The Cat Is Out Of The Bag

name: Unelmia Italiassa
summary: A series about Ellen Jokikunnas and her spouse Jari fulfilling their long-time dreams takes viewers to the stunning landscapes of Italy. They have dreamed of a second home in Italy but thought they could only make that dream come true after having a child. However, life can't wait forever, so they buy a 200-year-old stone house in Italy and start renovating it.

name: Der Kinderpsychiater - Die Macht des Dr. Winterhoff

previousepisode.name: This House is My Castle! / Mikan and the Cherry Blossom Viewing / Everybody's Dream

name: Australia: An Unofficial History
summary: Delves into a forgotten vault of Australian government films, unearthing a kaleidoscopic vision of Australia in the 1970s, a decade of political and social change.

name: Alles im Loth! Die Kader und Isi Story
summary: In the new docu-soap "Alles im Loth! Die Kader und Isi Story" Kader fulfills her life's dream. She opens a beauty salon in Berlin. Always by her side: her husband Isi. He lends his wife a hand and supports her wherever he can. Nevertheless, the two face a number of challenges. Will the power couple master everything or is their dream in danger of being shattered before the opening?

previousepisode.name: Alles im Lot(h) oder alles im Eimer?

name: Wild Holland
summary: A unique wetland area of Europe is captured in an important moment of change: a time when new life is flooding back into the delta. Sweeping scenes capturing the beauty of these waterways contrast with intimate, eye-opening portraits of resident animals. Explore the delta through the eyes of the white-tailed sea eagle, the beaver, the hare, the stickleback, and the large blue butterfly.

name: The Sword
summary: Xie Xiaofeng, the third young master of Shenjian Villa, was tired of the rivers and lakes, abandoned his birthtime and wealth and reputation in the martial arts, and pretended to live at the bottom of the society under the pseudonym Aji after his death, but he couldn't help himself in the rivers and lakes, he had to reappear in the rivers and lakes, and finally Xie Yan's first battle began, but at this time, Yan Shisan had realized a more powerful sword move, just when Xie Xiaofeng was about to die in the fifteenth sword of Yan Shisan's "Thirteen Swords", Yan Shisan's horizontal sword committed suicide, Xie Xiaofeng pondered... finally knew that Yan Shisan committed suicide because he had saved himself first, and secondly, he didn't want the fifteenth change of the most vicious move of the "Thirteen Swords to Kill" to exist in the world, so Xie Xiaofeng also cut off his right hand, and no longer used the sword for the rest of his life, and returned to the rivers and lakes...

name: Time is Money
summary: Time is Money is a high-stakes quiz show that offers a unique twist: contestants begin with their prize money already on the line and must race against the clock to keep it. If they fail to answer correctly, their cash prize slips away. The final player remaining will take home everything they've managed to save — making every decision a potential game-changer.

name: The Ridge
summary: Mia is fleeing addiction and leaving behind a professional life in tatters in Scotland. She accepts a wedding invitation from her estranged sister in New Zealand – only to find the would-be-bride dead upon arrival. Caught up in grief and pulled by a dark attraction to her late-sister's fiancé Ewan, Mia soon finds that familiarity among a small community breeds secrets and tensions, endangering the brittle fabric of the town itself.

name: Katie Piper's Weekend Escape
summary:
The host of this brand new series is television presenter Katie Piper. The show will be shot at an exclusive retreat located in the British Countryside celebrating the very best of our country's natural beauty. Each week Katie and a celebrity guest will be introduced to new pamper treatments and fun activities focused on health and wellbeing. Meanwhile, a nutritionist and health-food expert will be on hand to introduce Katie and her guest to a range of drinks and foods throughout each show.

In addition to its focus on lifestyle and wellbeing, Katie Piper's Weekend Escape will also feature powerful human-interest stories. A segment entitled ‘Katie's Haircut Hero' will throw the spotlight on someone who has braved adversity or done something extraordinary for an individual or community. The ‘hero' will be rewarded with a session with celebrity hairdresser Michael Douglas, whose mission is to help people feel confident about their hair and themselves. Michael has previously appeared on The One Show, This MorningandGood Morning Britain.

name: The Wildest City in The World: Anchorage
summary: See the incredible stories of the people and animals that live side-by-side in one of the most remote and extreme cities on earth: Anchorage, Alaska. Combining specially shot footage of Anchorage's unique urban wildlife, stylized reconstructions of dramatic animal incidents, and observational sequences following the city's biologists, this is a story to set the mind alight.

name: The Lead
summary: The TV drama, The Lead, tells the story of Qinqiang opera actress Yi Qin'e, who is brought into the troupe by her uncle, Hu Sanyuan, by accident. Over nearly half a century of rises and falls, glories and declines, she grows from a shepherdess into a renowned Qinqiang opera star. At the same time, through the winding journey of Qinqiang opera, the drama mirrors the emotional lives and destinies of ordinary people amid four decades of transformation in Chinese society.

name: Bua & Kwan: The Opposites of Love & Hate
summary: Getting married is a great way to fall in love.

name: Tai Ngao Jan
summary: Satayu, a businessman from the powerful Sasiwong family, never knew love until he met Paboo, a young woman raised in a broken home and spoiled by money, making her selfish and fickle. Her new position at Sasiwong Group is a test for her. She has to work with Satayu and Buri, a warm-hearted architect from a modest but loving family. Paboo forms bonds with both men. In the end, who will win her heart?

name: Johng Kol Khing Tian
summary: Son and Tienkanya grew up together, Son is her adopted brother. They live together in the same house with Tienkanya's father and younger brother Gomut. When Gomut dies from an illness, Tienkanya meets Apphanda at his funeral. Apphanda befriends Tienkanya and seduces her. Tienkanya believes she has found the man of her dreams and quickly marries him, though the person she trust the most Son disapproves.
